action_items: Consider aligning provider count between code (20) and UI copy that claims 22 — either add 2 more bank_pos entries or update ModuleFooter text in PaymentsAdmin.js:427,429.
(Optional) statement-match amount parser assumes Turkish '1.234,56' format; plain '1499.00' is misparsed as 149900. Document expected format or auto-detect.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/smart_pos.py POST /provider/{key}/config directly mutates os.environ[env_name] on save (line 410) — this leaks per-request user input into the process env of the FastAPI worker. Under multi-worker/uvicorn setups only the receiving worker sees the change, causing inconsistent behavior across workers until restart. Prefer reading from db.settings on demand (which the GET already does) instead of mirroring to os.environ.

routes/smart_pos.py POST /provider/{key}/config accepts arbitrary keys in payload.values but only whitelist iterates configured_env — this is safe, but the DB doc stores extra fields silently (upsert of new_values=dict(doc)). Consider strict filtering to only configured_env keys before persist.
routes/payments.py /havale/statement-upload has no auth check — anyone can upload up to 15MB PDF; recommend admin auth (X-Master-License header) same as other admin endpoints.

routes/payments.py /havale/statement-match auto_approve path also has no auth — malicious caller could push arbitrary TRFxxx text and trigger paid status on their own pending orders. This is CRITICAL for production. Add master-license header check.

routes/payments.py amount regex ([\d.]+[.,]\d{2}) is ambiguous for '.' — with '1499.00' it produces 149900 kuruş instead of 1499 TL (test confirmed). Add TR-specific parsing or require thousands separator to be '.'.

PaymentsAdmin.js PosConfigModal (line 598-602) sets state during render (setTestMode/setEnabled/setInitialized inside the render body). This works but is a React anti-pattern; should use useEffect on cfg.data change.
PaymentsAdmin.js file is now 835 lines with 4 major components — recommend splitting SmartPosPanel, PosConfigModal, StatementMatchForm, OrdersKanban into separate files under /components/payments/.

OrdersKanban drag-drop only supports awaiting/notified → paid/failed; a user dragging a paid card triggers 'geçiş desteklenmiyor' toast but no visual indicator that source column is un-draggable — consider disabling draggable={false} for terminal statuses.
PaymentsAdmin.js ModuleFooter footer (line 427-431) claims 22 providers / 14 bank POS — mismatch with real count (20/12).
